title: geranium × oxonianum f. thurstonianum
intro: Geranium × oxonianum f. thurstonianum, commonly known as hardy geranium, is a perennial flowering plant species within the Geraniaceae family. It is known for its attractive, blue-purple flowers and hardy nature, making it a popular choice for gardens in temperate climates. The health benefits of Geranium × oxonianum f. thurstonianum include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant therapeutic actions.
